characters.label: Recurring finance and economics presenter
characters.prompt: Original fictional Black male finance presenter in his thirties with warm brown skin, short sculpted loc twists and a clean taper, black rectangular glasses, a neatly trimmed goatee, tailored deep-indigo suit, pale blue shirt, copper tie, restrained gold circuit lapel pin, and brown cap-toe dress shoes with a subtle red-and-gold Spanish floral textile. Consistent adult proportions, friendly analytical expression, fully visible hands and feet. A light application of woodblock print and vox newspaper with rich anime colors.
characters.negative_prompt: No paper-craft, puppet or cut-out construction, no toy proportions, no photorealism, no celebrity likeness, no childish styling, no generated words, numbers, charts, logos, currency symbols, or watermarks.

characters.label: The same presenter at acquisition abstraction - shorts, listicles, thumbnails
characters.prompt: The same original fictional Black male finance presenter in his thirties, warm brown skin, drawn as a flat high-contrast cartoon that stays legible when he fills five percent of a phone screen. He keeps exactly the features that survive simplification: short sculpted loc twists with a clean taper, black rectangular glasses, a neatly trimmed goatee, a flat deep-indigo suit block and a flat copper tie block. Thick uniform black outlines, solid colour fills, a large readable head, simple clearly-separated hands, plain white ground, friendly analytical expression, fully visible hands and feet.
characters.negative_prompt: No lapel pin, no pocket square, no patterned or textured shoes, no suit tailoring detail, no paper or woodblock texture, no shading gradients, no photorealism, no celebrity likeness, no generated words, numbers, charts, logos, currency symbols, or watermarks.
